graders.name: held-out-sandbox-render-roundtrip-and-never-clobber

goal: The flywheel.toml that init renders carries a commented [sandbox] section with a `setup = "uv sync"` example that round-trips through load_policy into WorkPolicy.sandbox_setup when uncommented, and re-running init still leaves an existing flywheel.toml byte-for-byte unchanged.

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py -- _INIT_POLICY_TAIL (line 1699): append a commented [sandbox] block with a `# setup = "uv sync"` example, mirroring the existing commented [agent] / [[defaults.graders]] style so the default stays bare

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_policy.py -- _optional_sandbox_setup (387-404) reads `[sandbox] setup` into WorkPolicy.sandbox_setup (default None at line 145); the rendered key name and value must be exactly what this parser reads

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_policy.py:633 -- the [sandbox] setup suite (test_sandbox_setup_default_none / _parses / _rejects_empty) pins the parse contract and the historical `sandbox_setup is None` default; keep all three green
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_init.py:107 test_init_is_idempotent_and_never_clobbers -- the never-clobber guard the [sandbox] addition must not regress
constraints: SHARED INVARIANT SI-2: the only config key is `[sandbox] setup` read into WorkPolicy.sandbox_setup; this is 00028's SOLE addition to the shared _INIT_POLICY_TAIL template. Render the example as `uv sync` (the workspace install command). Do not rename the key or invent a parallel one.

SHARED INVARIANT SI-1 (boundary): _INIT_POLICY_TAIL is also touched by spec 00026 ([submit] base). Append your [sandbox] block as a NEW commented block; do not rewrite or reorder existing tail content. If 00026 has already landed when this runs, rebase onto it and keep both blocks (distinct tables, no key collision).

Keep the [sandbox] block COMMENTED by default so a policy that declares no [sandbox] still loads with sandbox_setup is None (must-not-regress); the one-edit (uncomment) path must yield policy.sandbox_setup == "uv sync".
Re-running init against an existing flywheel.toml non-interactively must leave it byte-for-byte unchanged and report it left untouched (criterion 8 / never-clobber).
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.
non_goals: Do not modify files under .flywheel/holdout/ -- the out-of-band held-out grading surface for criteria 5, 6, 8 (authored separately); do not create, read, or weaken anything there.
Do not delete or weaken the test_policy.py [sandbox] suite or the test_init.py idempotency test; any relaxed assertion needs a named equal-or-stronger replacement (criterion 10).
Do not change the default to an UNCOMMENTED setup line -- that would run an install command in every adopter's worktree and change the historical bare-sandbox default (D-2).
Do not add a [submit] base key or any [submit] scaffolding (owned by spec 00026, SI-1).
Do not enforce or run the setup command; the worker already reads policy.sandbox_setup -- this task only scaffolds config (out of scope).
edge_cases: The rendered text must satisfy BOTH a `[sandbox]` header (possibly commented) and a `setup`-key line referencing `uv sync` -- a header with no setup example, or a setup value that installs nothing, leaves the empty-grader footgun unchanged (criterion 5 defense).

Uncommenting must strip the leading `# ` from both the header and the setup line and still parse: a key name or value the parser does not read makes the documented edit a silent no-op (criterion 6 defense).
notes: Held-out graders for criteria 5, 6, 8 run from .flywheel/holdout/00028-onboarding-preflight-and-auth out-of-band; the visible test_policy.py sandbox suite is the composition seam between the rendered scaffold and the parser.
